evidence: Quick Design-only localization/i18n review of specs/spec.md, design/design.md, and design/contract.json. The provisional Design changes synchronous Python governance, native-dispatch observation, Git-checkout evidence, and exact-SHA terminal projections; it introduces no locale catalog, translated UI or notification copy, locale-sensitive input or formatting, currency handling, future-event scheduling, bidi layout/interpolation, or human-readable text slicing/collation surface. The i18n lens is therefore explicitly non-applicable to this Design.
